title: 5.5.4 Debugging: The round that never ends
description: Two planted bugs. The ball falls into the pit, the word Game over appears, and the ball keeps falling anyway. Find both.

steps.title: Run it
steps.instructions: The ball drops into the pit and never comes back. Game over shows, but the ball is still moving off the bottom of the screen: the flag is set and nothing reads it.

steps.title: Bug 1: the flag is set but never read
steps.instructions: The `if (playing)` guard is missing from the movement/score branch. Wrap the part that only belongs to a live round in `if (playing) { ... }`.

steps.title: Bug 2: R does not set the flag back
steps.instructions: R puts the ball back but leaves `playing` false, so the next round is over before it starts. Set `playing = true` in the R branch.

requirements.title: The round is guarded
requirements.description: The live-round work sits inside an if on the playing/lost flag, so it stops when the round is over. Help: 5.5.1 (Reading: The state of the game)

requirements.title: R sets the flag back
requirements.description: The R branch sets the round running again, as well as moving the ball. Help: 5.5.1 (Reading: The state of the game)
